techcrunch.title: Investors love AI, as long as you’re a cloud host
techcrunch.description: Amazon isn't slowing down on data center spending — but investors don't seem to mind.

techcrunch.title: Apple says gaming slowdown and App Store changes hurt services growth
techcrunch.description: Apple said a slowdown in mobile gaming and changes to the App Store’s business model — including court-ordered payment rule changes in the U.S. — weighed on its services business, even as the company topped 1.5 billion paid subscriptions.

techcrunch.title: Judge says Trump admin still lacks evidence for Anthropic ‘supply-chain risk’ label
techcrunch.description: A federal judge said the Trump administration has not presented enough evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply-chain risk, casting doubt on the government's ban on its AI technology.

techcrunch.title: CareCloud begins to notify hundreds of thousands after hackers stole medical records
techcrunch.description: The health tech data giant, which handles vast amounts of patients' medical data, said hackers struck one of its protected health data stores.

techcrunch.title: Friend, the lonely AI wearable, returns with a new voice and a much bigger price tag
techcrunch.description: Friend, the AI wearable, can now talk to its users — for an enhanced price.

techcrunch.title: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
techcrunch.description: As experts have warned for the last two years, some companies — like Microsoft and now Google — are finding and patching an exponential number of bugs in their products, thanks to the use of LLMs and AI tools.

techcrunch.title: Florida plans to build air taxi pads using $200M intended for EV chargers
techcrunch.description: Florida wants to use federal EV charger funds to build an air taxi network connecting golf courses, luxury apartment buildings, and airports.

techcrunch.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
techcrunch.description: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.

techcrunch.title: Synthetic-user startup Simile raises $200M at $2B valuation 5 months after $100M Series A
techcrunch.description: Add another member to the fast-and-furious AI unicorn club: Simile.

techcrunch.title: Spotify launches ‘User Notes’ to let users add memories to songs
techcrunch.description: Spotify says the new feature is designed to let users add personal captions to their favorite songs, such as noting why a track was added to a playlist or when they first discovered it

techcrunch.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso — source says for about $200M
techcrunch.description: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.

techcrunch.title: Tesla made its 10 millionth EV
techcrunch.description: The milestone means Tesla is halfway to accomplishing one of the four core product goals Elon Musk has to hit to unlock his full $1 trillion pay package.

techcrunch.title: When will fusion power startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems go public?
techcrunch.description: There are fresh signs that fusion power startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems will list in the next two to three years.

techcrunch.title: Meta says AI is making it easier to build new apps — and more are coming
techcrunch.description: Meta says AI is making it dramatically easier to build and launch new consumer apps, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg telling investors the company has more new consumer products on the way.

techcrunch.title: Netflix lands global streaming deal for ‘The Walking Dead’
techcrunch.description: Netflix just signed a massive new licensing agreement worth $500 million to bring The Walking Dead Universe to international markets.

techcrunch.title: Nscale buys Anyscale as it seeks to own more of the AI compute stack
techcrunch.description: British AI neocloud Nscale is buying software startup Anyscale, which helps companies scale their AI workloads across data centers and servers.

techcrunch.title: Fusion power darling Commonwealth Fusion Systems raises another $1B
techcrunch.description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems raised $1 billion as the startup moves toward its first commercial fusion power plant.

techcrunch.title: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
techcrunch.description: A new study estimates only 2,000 U.S. engineers have the expertise to deliver meaningful AI ROI, as enterprises race to hire forward-deployed engineers to implement AI at scale.

techcrunch.title: In the Hugging Face breach, OpenAI’s hacker was noisy and fast — but not unstoppable
techcrunch.description: Cybersecurity experts told TechCrunch that one of the biggest lessons to be taken from the OpenAI hack against Hugging Face has nothing to do with AI, but traditional cybersecurity defense.

techcrunch.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s biggest stage features leaders from Amazon, Replit, Tether, with much more to come
techcrunch.description: The Disrupt Stage is where many of the biggest conversations in technology happen, with a legacy that stretches back for more than a decade.
